messages:
Diego: Tossing up an idea: sticky invoice header + inline token summary so when you scroll a long org invoice list you still see totals and unit toggle. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/sticky-header.png
Hannah: Ooh yes. Right now headers disappear and finance folks lose context when comparing rows. Sticky header should include 'Display as: tokens | compute units' toggle.
Renee: Be careful with wording. If we expose a toggle that changes visible units across page, exports must indicate what units were used. CSV should include a column 'units_type' and a header row comment.
Mark: Implementation note: sticky header needs to be position:sticky; top: 0; but also consider z-index and not overlapping row focus outlines. Add 1px box-shadow to separate.
Diego: Also thinking of pinning the download CTA per-row into the header when multiple rows selected. Users often select many invoices and hit download but then scroll.
Hannah: Selection UX: add a bulk checkbox in header and floating action (Download) that appears when >0 selected. Works well on mobile too.
Renee: For exports, server should accept query param `units=compute|tokens` and `expand_breakdowns=true`. That way downloads are deterministic regardless of client state.
Mark: CSV shape: always include invoice_id, project_id (nullable for org totals), units_type, total_units, and if expand_breakdowns=true include columns: line_item_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens. That will avoid downstream ambiguity.
ui-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure unit toggle is keyboard operable and readable by screenreaders. Use role="tablist" or native radio group. Announce changes with aria-live region.
Diego: Good call. For visual copy on toggle: use 'Tokens' and 'Compute units (aka tokens)' in the tooltip; keep primary label 'Tokens' to avoid breaking existing integrations.
Hannah: Small copy nit: in invoice row show compact format '2.3k' but expose exact number in aria-label and tooltip. E.g., aria-label='2,345 tokens'.
Renee: Agree. Also confirm rounding rules across UI and exports so numbers match. No show/round mismatch.
Mark: Dev estimates: sticky header + selection + floating CTA ~2 dev days, unit toggle + export param support ~2-3 days backend, CSV formatting and docs ~1 day, A11y pass ~1 day.
Diego: Acceptance criteria I'll put in the PR: sticky header present, unit toggle in header with keyboard support, bulk select + floating download, export accepts units and expand_breakdowns, CSV has units_type and breakdown columns, exact numbers in aria-labels/tooltips, visual QA for overlap and contrast.
Hannah: I'll prototype the keyboard flows and microcopy.
Renee: I'll coordinate with finance to confirm CSV column names.
Mark: Tagging @backend for index review and @ops for migration note.
ui-bot: Checklist added: contrast >=4.5, focus visible, aria-live updates, export param documented.
Diego: Thanks all — will upload updated mock and link PR shortly. :rocket:
